definitions.gloss: view; prospect; outlook; scenery from a high point
definitions.explanation: The view or panorama visible from an elevated or open location. Emphasizes the breadth and quality of what can be seen.

examples.japanese: ここは{見晴|みは}らしがいい。
examples.english: The view is great from here.

examples.japanese: {丘|おか}の{上|うえ}から{見晴|みは}らしを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed the view from the top of the hill.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{海|うみ}が{見|み}える{見晴|みは}らしのよい{部屋|へや}です。
examples.english: This room has a nice view overlooking the ocean.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the pattern {見晴|みは}らしがいい (good view) or {見晴|みは}らしが{悪|わる}い (poor view). Also appears in place names such as {見晴|みは}らし{台|だい} (observation point).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見晴|みは}らしがいい (to have a good view)
- {見晴|みは}らしが{悪|わる}い (to have a poor view)
- {見晴|みは}らし{台|だい} (observation deck, lookout point)
- {見晴|みは}らしのよい{場所|ばしょ} (a place with a good view)
